title: 生物风险管理：个人防护装备
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/41_BIORISK MANAGEMENT PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/41_BIORISK MANAGEMENT PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT/src.py

points.K1: 个人防护是最后一道防线
points.K4: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入
points.K6: 呼吸器靠密封，也有局限
points.K7: 适合性测试：闻不到才合格

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着白色防护服，戴着护目镜，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a white protective suit and goggles and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲个人防护。
overlay: 生物风险管理：个人防护装备

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一副手套和一个防护口罩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pair of gloves and a respirator.
shots.narration: 穿戴对了，才真的护得住。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在更衣区，面前货架上摆满各种防护用品，一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in a changing area in front of shelves full of protective equipment, looking confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进二级实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一个口罩又放下，再拿起一副手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a mask, puts it down, then picks up a pair of gloves.
shots.narration: 他不知道该穿哪些。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，手里拿着空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 小研说：选什么，看评估。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 三层盾牌，最外面是房子，中间是文件，最里面是一个穿防护服的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Three nested shields: a building outermost, a document in the middle and a figure in protective clothing innermost. No people.
shots.narration: 设施和规程在前，
overlay: 个人防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 最里层的防护盾牌亮起
shots.prompt_en: The innermost protective shield lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护是最后一道防线。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 小研对着镜子整理防护服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her protective suit in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 用得对，才能真正挡住风险。

shots.scene: 小研全套防护：口罩、护目镜、防护服、手套、鞋套，逐一亮起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in full protective gear; mask, goggles, suit, gloves and shoe covers light up one by one.
shots.narration: 呼吸、眼睛、皮肤、手和脚，

shots.scene: 阿杰手腕处手套和袖口之间露出一截皮肤，红圈圈出
shots.prompt_en: A gap of bare skin between the young male student's glove and sleeve, circled in red.
shots.narration: 哪里露着皮肤，

shots.scene: 小研帮阿杰把手套拉过袖口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student pull his glove over his cuff.
shots.narration: 哪里就是防护缺口。

shots.scene: 五个图标排开：口罩、手套、防护服、护目镜、送风头罩
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a mask, gloves, a protective suit, goggles and a powered hood. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品分五大类：

shots.scene: 图标依次跳动
shots.prompt_en: The five icons bounce one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 口罩、手套、防护服、护目和特殊防护。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入
shots.scene: 人头侧面图，小红点从鼻口进入气道
shots.prompt_en: A side view of a head showing small red dots entering the airway through the nose and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 有的病原经气溶胶吸进来，
overlay: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入
shots.scene: 防护口罩挡在鼻口前，小红点被拦住
shots.prompt_en: A respirator in front of the nose and mouth stops the red dots. No people.
shots.narration: 要靠防护口罩挡住。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入
shots.scene: 货架上一排不同款式的防护口罩
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a row of different respirator styles, all blank. No people.
shots.narration: 口罩款式很多，

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入
shots.scene: 小研戴上口罩，旁边一个测试头罩图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a respirator next to a fit test hood icon.
shots.narration: 选好的还要做适合性测试。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：防经呼吸道进入
shots.scene: 口罩被喷消毒剂后变形，循环图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A mask deformed after being sprayed with disinfectant, and a reuse icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒会损坏口罩，不要重复用。

shots.scene: 两个外形相似的口罩并排，一个上面有液滴图标打勾，一个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two similar respirators side by side: one with a droplet icon and a check, the other with a cross. No people.
shots.narration: 外形差不多的口罩，

shots.scene: 小研拿着口罩包装盒，看空白说明栏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the blank label on a respirator box.
shots.narration: 有的能防液体喷溅，有的不行。

shots.scene: 包装盒上的空白说明被放大镜放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the blank label on the box. No people.
shots.narration: 用前看清说明和用途。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器靠密封，也有局限
shots.scene: 粉尘、烟雾、纤维和小红点图标都被口罩挡住
shots.prompt_en: Icons of dust, smoke, fibers and small red dots all blocked by a respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 防护口罩挡粉尘、雾和生物气溶胶，
overlay: 呼吸器靠密封，也有局限

shots.section_title: 呼吸器靠密封，也有局限
shots.scene: 口罩边缘紧贴面部，一圈绿色密封线
shots.prompt_en: A respirator edge sealed against a face, outlined with a green sealing line. No people.
shots.narration: 它靠紧贴面部形成密封。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器靠密封，也有局限
shots.scene: 油滴图标穿过口罩，打问号
shots.prompt_en: An oil droplet icon passing through a respirator with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有些型号不防油性颗粒，

shots.section_title: 呼吸器靠密封，也有局限
shots.scene: 液体喷溅打在口罩上渗进去，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A liquid splash soaking through a respirator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有些不耐液体，不能当医用口罩。

shots.section_title: 适合性测试：闻不到才合格
shots.scene: 小研戴着口罩，头上罩着透明测试头罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a respirator under a clear fit test hood.
shots.narration: 每个人脸型不同，
overlay: 适合性测试：闻不到才合格

shots.section_title: 适合性测试：闻不到才合格
shots.scene: 王老师用喷雾器往头罩里喷雾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sprays a mist into the hood with a small nebulizer.
shots.narration: 测试时往头罩里喷有味道的雾，

shots.section_title: 适合性测试：闻不到才合格
shots.scene: 小研摇头表示闻不到，王老师在空白表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and the safety administrator ticks a blank form.
shots.narration: 闻不到、尝不到，才算合适。

shots.section_title: 适合性测试：闻不到才合格
shots.scene: 日历上标出上岗日期，测试图标在前
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a start date marked, a fit test icon placed before it. No people.
shots.narration: 上岗前就要测好。

shots.scene: 三副手套：乳胶、腈、加厚加强款
shots.prompt_en: Three pairs of gloves: latex, nitrile and thick reinforced gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 手套分好几种。

shots.scene: 乳胶手套碰到溶剂瓶图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A latex glove touching a solvent bottle icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 乳胶手套挡不住很多有机溶剂，

shots.scene: 腈手套旁边一个感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A nitrile glove with an exclamation mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 腈手套耐溶剂，但也有局限。

shots.scene: 小研戴上两层手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on two layers of gloves.
shots.narration: 处理生物材料建议戴两层，

shots.scene: 外层手套沾了液体，小研摘下外层，里层仍干净
shots.prompt_en: The outer glove gets wet; the female graduate student removes it, and the inner glove stays clean.
shots.narration: 外层污染了，里层还能护着。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴加强手套抓住一只小鼠
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears thick reinforced gloves to hold a laboratory mouse.
shots.narration: 抓动物用加强手套，防咬防抓。

shots.scene: 小研穿着一次性防护服在实验室里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a disposable protective suit in the laboratory.
shots.narration: 防护服在实验室和现场都能穿，

shots.scene: 小液滴打在防护服上被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Small droplets hit the protective suit and are stopped. No people.
shots.narration: 能挡小飞溅，

shots.scene: 一大摊液体泼向防护服，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A large splash of liquid thrown at a suit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 挡不住大量溢洒。

shots.scene: 防护服图标旁边：一次性图标和硬币图标
shots.prompt_en: A protective suit icon next to a single-use icon and a coin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性使用，成本也不低。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears goggles and a face shield.
shots.narration: 护目镜和面屏，护住眼睛，

shots.scene: 液滴打在面屏上被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Droplets hit the face shield and are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住小飞溅。

shots.scene: 小红点从面屏下方绕进口鼻，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Small red dots drift around the bottom of a face shield toward the nose and mouth, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 面屏不防吸入，

shots.scene: 面屏图标加上呼吸防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A face shield icon combined with a respiratory protection icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有气溶胶，要加呼吸防护。

shots.scene: 小研戴着透明送风头罩，腰间挂着送风机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a clear powered air hood with a blower unit on her belt.
shots.narration: 送风式呼吸器：

shots.scene: 剖面图：风机吸入空气，经过滤器送进头罩
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway: the blower draws in air through a filter and sends it into the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 风机把空气过滤后送进头罩，

shots.scene: 头罩内箭头向外，标加号
shots.prompt_en: Arrows pointing outward inside the hood, marked with a plus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 脸前保持正压，

shots.scene: 空气从下摆流出，形成一圈气幕，小红点被吹开
shots.prompt_en: Air flows out from the bottom edge forming an air curtain that pushes small red dots away. No people.
shots.narration: 从下摆流出，形成气幕。

shots.scene: 小研在安全柜前操作，头罩完好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a safety cabinet with the hood on.
shots.narration: 防气溶胶，也防飞溅。

shots.scene: 正压防护服图标连着一根送气管
shots.prompt_en: A positive pressure suit icon connected to an air supply hose. No people.
shots.narration: 四级实验室穿正压防护服，

shots.scene: 防护服上一个小破口，空气向外喷
shots.prompt_en: A small tear in the suit with air blowing outward. No people.
shots.narration: 破了口，空气也是往外流。

shots.scene: 防护服图标旁一堆硬币
shots.prompt_en: A suit icon next to a pile of coins. No people.
shots.narration: 这种防护服非常昂贵。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰看一张空白表格，表头是防护用品图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student look at a blank table with protective equipment icons in the header.
shots.narration: 选防护，第一看病原的风险组。

shots.scene: 表格左列一到四行，越往下勾的防护越多
shots.prompt_en: A table with four rows; lower rows have more check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 风险越高，防护越强。

shots.scene: 问号病原图标旁边，最高级防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A pathogen icon with a question mark next to the highest level protection icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不明的新病原，先按最高防护。

shots.scene: 老周在空白评估表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 具体由评估确定，表只是起点。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上：眼、口鼻、皮肤、针头四个位置亮起
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with the eyes, nose and mouth, skin and a needle icon lighting up. No people.
shots.narration: 第二看侵入途径：

shots.scene: 眼睛对护目镜，口鼻对口罩，皮肤对防护服
shots.prompt_en: Lines link the eyes to goggles, the nose and mouth to a mask, and the skin to a suit. No people.
shots.narration: 从哪里进，就挡住哪里。

shots.scene: 针头图标对加强手套和利器盒
shots.prompt_en: A needle icon linked to reinforced gloves and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 多种途径，就多重防护。

shots.scene: 一排操作图标：收样、转移、检测、核酸提取、扩增、废物、动物
shots.prompt_en: A row of task icons: receiving samples, transferring, testing, extraction, amplification, waste and animals. No people.
shots.narration: 第三看具体操作。

shots.scene: 小研接收样本盒，戴手套、口罩、穿防护服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student receives a sample box wearing gloves, a mask and a protective suit.
shots.narration: 接收样本，穿戴基本防护；

shots.scene: 离心和提取操作图标周围冒出小雾点
shots.prompt_en: Small mist dots around centrifuge and extraction icons. No people.
shots.narration: 核酸提取、离心会产生气溶胶，

shots.scene: 小研换上送风头罩，在安全柜里操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches to a powered air hood and works in the safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 这类操作要加强防护。

shots.scene: 小鼠、兔子和大型动物图标排开
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a mouse, a rabbit and a large animal in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 和动物打交道，要多想几点：

shots.scene: 小鼠张嘴图标，旁边抓痕图标
shots.prompt_en: A mouse icon with an open mouth next to a scratch mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 动物多大、会不会咬人抓人，

shots.scene: 动物图标里有小红点，旁边人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An animal icon containing small red dots next to a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 是否携带人兽共患病原，

shots.scene: 野外图标和实验室图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A field icon and a laboratory icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 在野外还是实验室，从哪儿感染。

shots.scene: 大型动物旁边，一套专门的防护用品图标
shots.prompt_en: A set of special protective equipment icons beside a large animal. No people.
shots.narration: 大动物要专门的防护。

shots.scene: 防护用品图标和文件夹图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Protective equipment icons next to a folder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护离不开管理。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师在空白评估表上讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator discuss a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 先充分评估，再选防护，

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰演示穿脱，墙上一张空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the young male student how to put on and take off protective gear beside a blank flow chart.
shots.narration: 穿和脱都要培训，

shots.scene: 阿杰照着流程一步步穿戴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows the chart step by step to put on his gear.
shots.narration: 按规程一步步来。

shots.scene: 防护服袖子撕破，小研在空白记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student logs a torn sleeve of a protective suit in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 防护服破了，要记录上报，

shots.scene: 审核图标和记录本图标
shots.prompt_en: An audit icon next to a logbook icon. No people.
shots.narration: 审核时一并检查。

shots.scene: 包装盒上的空白日期被圈出，过期的一盒被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank date on a box is circled and an expired box is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品有有效期，过期不用。

shots.scene: 用过的防护服装进生物危害袋，送去高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Used protective suits go into a biohazard bag and then to an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 用后按废物规程灭菌或焚烧。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边三个图标：生物危害标志、人体轮廓、试管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a biohazard symbol, a body outline and a test tube.
shots.narration: 选防护三步：

shots.scene: 三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three icons light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 看风险组，看途径，看操作。

shots.scene: 防护用品图标和文件夹图标握手
shots.prompt_en: A protective equipment icon and a folder icon shake hands. No people.
shots.narration: 穿脱按规程，用品合格不过期。

shots.scene: 欣欣和穿好全套防护的阿杰一起向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student in full protective gear wave goodbye together.
shots.narration: 最后一道防线，守好它，再见！
